propositions: Data Center backend has no unit-level characterization test pinning values; only Cloud's test_backend_characterization.py pins values while DC's test_backend_contract.py asserts only shape

The create-path mapper _map_local_to_dc_fields must be pinned by value for every emitted key: summary, description, issuetype, priority, status, assignee including default-fallback branches and empty-string fallbacks

The shared OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote must be exercised through WikiTextCodec to pin description fit-to-limit behavior and non-string passthrough, ensuring DC composition defects are caught

DC's probe branches (PRESENT_RESOLVED, PRESENT_FILTERED, ARCHIVED_OR_MOVED, UNREACHABLE) must be pinned through the real classifier, not FakeTransport.probe_remote which returns UNREACHABLE unconditionally

DC must bind its own configured resolved_statuses rather than Cloud's hardcoded set, provable only with a non-default status set since both defaults are byte-identical frozenset({Resolved, Done, Cancelled})
Every pin must be mutation-checked: perturbing each pinned value must cause exactly that pin to fail, recorded in both ticket comments and test module documentation
